## Summary

Describe the specification, fixture, or documentation change.

## Language impact

Explain whether observable behavior changes. If it does, identify affected
implementations, compatibility risks, security implications, and the required
language-version change.

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `python3 scripts/validate_repository.py`.
- [ ] I added or updated conformance fixtures for observable behavior changes.
- [ ] I updated `VERSION`, the fixture directory, and `CHANGELOG.md` if the
      language version changed.
- [ ] I kept unresolved proposals clearly marked as proposals.
- [ ] I read and accept `CONTRIBUTOR_TERMS.md`.
